_base.description: Inherited by every analyzer, named or not. Only machine-written code is excluded; no hand-written Go in this repo is exempted, per-file or otherwise. Patterns are matched against the execroot-relative file name, e.g. 'agent/internal/xds/cache/cache.go', 'bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/api/aether/cni/v1/.../cni.pb.go', 'external/<canonical-repo>/foo.go' — hence the anchors below.

exclude_files.(^|/)external/: Dependency sources. nogo's validation action reaches the Go targets of external repositories too, so without this a routine dependency bump could fail our build on a finding in code we cannot edit. No path in this repository lives under 'external/'.
exclude_files.(^|/)bazel-out/: Bazel action outputs. Everything under bazel-out is machine-written into a tree that is recreated on every build; a finding there is a bug in the generator, not something to patch here.
exclude_files.\\.pb\\.go$: protoc-gen-go output (//api/**). Overlaps the bazel-out rule above on purpose, so the exclusion does not depend on which output tree the generated sources happen to land in.
exclude_files.\\.pb\\.dynamo\\.go$: protoc-gen-dynamo output, the DynamoDB attribute marshalling. Same reasoning as .pb.go.
exclude_files.zz_generated\\.deepcopy\\.go$: controller-gen deepcopy output (//common/apis/**). Regenerated by controller-gen, and the Kubernetes deepcopy idiom is not ours to change.
